name: Ryan Linn
biography: is a Senior Security Consultant with Trustwave's SpiderLabs who has a passion for making security knowledge accessible. In addition to being a columnist with the Ethical Hacker Network, Ryan has contributed to open source tools including Metasploit, Dradis and the Browser Exploitation Framework (BeEF).
